description: PB-28 is the designated RTO code for Malerkotla, which was formally established as the 23rd district of Punjab in 2021. The office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages all transport-related activities including vehicle registration, HSRP issuance, and driving licenses.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate Office, Malerkotla, District Malerkotla, Punjab
